mentions.name: Elephant Project
mentions.description: An electronic workbook and task generator app for learning Korean that provides AI feedback on exercises (with optional human feedback, which users currently have to find themselves). Developed over several years, with recent LLM progress making some originally conceived features easier to build; the author notes it still needs much more work.
mentions.source_excerpt: A electronic workbook/task generator app for korean learning with AI or human feedback (although for now you have to find the humans yourself).
mentions.author: ketzu
